//: FRAGMENT fixture for the KPI EDITORIAL TILE sub-component — one editorial-minimal cell (svelte display/KpiEditorialTile.svelte, keen `PureAdmin.Components.KpiEditorial.kpi_editorial_tile/1`). The parent kpi-editorial.json container defers these tile classes (fixture-ref → here). This is a FLAT-SIBLING fragment (same model as list-item.json): the root element is itself an ELEMENT of the container block — `pa-kpi-edit__tile` — and all its cells are FLAT SIBLINGS under the same `pa-kpi-edit__` prefix (`__label/__value/__num/__unit/__meta/__delta[/--*]/__target`), NOT `pa-kpi-edit__tile__*`. There are no `pa-kpi-edit__tile--*` modifiers and no `pa-kpi-edit__tile__*` sub-elements, so capability's reverse checks (scoped to `pa-kpi-edit__tile--` / `pa-kpi-edit__tile__`) are vacuously empty; the base class `pa-kpi-edit__tile` DOES exist in main.css, so there's no vacuous-scope note. The sibling cell classes are claimed via each feature's `produces` (forward-verified against main.css) and exercised by the goldens. The only block-with-modifiers here is the __delta cell: its five sentiment tints (--positive/--negative/--neutral/--up-strong/--down-strong) are produced by the `deltaVariant` enum; the BARE __delta (no variant) emits no tint class and the SCSS defaults it to --pa-positive. SCOPE: label + value (prefix/num/unit) + meta (delta + target). The detail popover (KpiDetailPopover / kpi_detail) is out of this slice (its own kpi-detail fragment fixture). The __target cell wraps its value after a literal `tgt` (both wrappers). Authored from snippets/kpi.html (EDITORIAL section) + _kpi-editorial-minimal.scss.
goldenConventions:
Root element is a
. __label ALWAYS renders (both wrappers emit it unconditionally; empty when no label). __value is the headline wrapper holding, in document order, an optional __unit prefix span, the __num span, and an optional __unit suffix span. __meta renders only when a delta and/or target is supplied; inside it, the __delta span (coloured, with an optional sentiment tint modifier) comes first, then the __target span whose content is a literal tgt followed by the target value. The bare __delta (no deltaVariant) emits no tint modifier. Class-token + attribute order and whitespace are normalized away, so goldens are written for readability.

propsVocabulary.labelText: uppercase mono caption — pa-kpi-edit__label (always rendered). svelte `labelText`, keen `label_text`.
propsVocabulary.valueText: headline thin numeral — pa-kpi-edit__num inside the __value wrapper. svelte `valueText`, keen `value_text`.
propsVocabulary.unit: unit/affix suffix — pa-kpi-edit__unit after the number. svelte `unit`, keen `unit_text`.
propsVocabulary.prefix: currency/scale prefix — pa-kpi-edit__unit before the number. svelte `prefix`, keen `prefix_text`.
propsVocabulary.deltaText: delta value in the meta row — pa-kpi-edit__delta (rendered only when set). svelte `deltaText`, keen `delta_text`.
propsVocabulary.deltaVariant: sentiment tint on the delta — pa-kpi-edit__delta--{variant}; default (nil) emits no tint (SCSS defaults the bare __delta to --pa-positive). svelte `deltaVariant`, keen `delta_variant` (underscore up_strong/down_strong dasherized to the class).
propsVocabulary.targetText: target value in the meta row — pa-kpi-edit__target, prefixed by a literal tgt (rendered only when set). svelte `targetText`, keen `target_text`.
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim to the tile (svelte `class`, keen `class`) — class passthrough, not a core feature.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css (grep '\.pa-kpi-edit__'). The root block pa-kpi-edit__tile has NO own modifiers/sub-elements (reverse checks vacuously empty; base class exists → no note). Sibling cell classes are claimed via `produces` + exercised by goldens. The only modifier family is on __delta — the five sentiment tints (deltaVariant enum); the default emits no tint. `produces: null` = structural/native (no class).
